input: 쇼핑몰 상품 리뷰를 긍정·부정으로 분류하려고 해. 추가 학습 없이 바로 쓸 수 있는 한국어 감성분석 모델이 필요하고, 상업적으로 써야 해.
outputs: The model is a Korean sentiment analysis tool specifically designed for classifying shopping mall product reviews into positive and negative categories. It supports the Korean language and is optimized for commercial use, making it ideal for businesses looking to analyze customer feedback without the need for additional training. With a parameter count of 110 million, this model offers a robust understanding of nuanced sentiments in Korean text. Its strengths lie in its high accuracy and efficiency, allowing for real-time analysis of large volumes of reviews. The model is available in GGUF format and is licensed for commercial applications, ensuring compliance with usage regulations.
